nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Purifying Foaming Cream Cleanser

avis.texte: Love how my skin feels after washing with this. My face feels so soft and sprinkle free, it looks dewy too.
This product is just "good." I always have to use a second cleanser because this one does not remove makeup.

I have very oily skin and I usually use their hydrating cleanser instead, which I love. This however made my skin so dry, didn't wash off my left over makeup at all, and made me breakout all over my face- even under my chin. I am also super pale so I get dark spots easily, this made them so hard to heal and my face looks patchy and red. Definitely do not reccomend if you use other strong products as well for acne or anything skincare related.

avis.titre: Not for those with stubborn acne
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin that's also prone to breakouts. I was hopeful that this product would be a good fit being gentle yet effective. It has cleared up blackheads on my nose but has left me with terrible breakouts on the rest of my skin. I do not recommend it for anyone who is prone to breakouts. It's also slightly drying, which I don't like.
I am combination skin, and I switched to this from the hydrating cleanser for two days, and it dried out my skin and gave me a few new whiteheads. I will be going back to the hydrating cleanser.

avis.titre: La Roche-Posay Toleraine Purifying Foaming Cleanser
avis.texte: This cleanser is soft, silky and very concentrated, which I love. But most importantly, it makes my skin feel smooth, silky and hydrated. A bonus is that it comes in a nice sized tube, great for traveling.

I have combo skin that isnt very sensitive but this face wash didnt do much for my skin, i think it dried out my skim barrier because now i have red patches. I heard it was great for others, just didnt work for me.

I got this cleanser because I read reviews that said it helped redness. I have not seen any improvement yet for myself with redness, but I will say that it has not made it worse, which is a good sign. My skin doesn't feel tight after washing, but it feels clean. no residue-y feel afterwards which is better than the Estee Lauder wash I've been using. so, comparatively, it's a cheaper product with a better result than what I've been using. Hopefully, it will continue to work well. I would like to see it help with the redness, but I think I will need to use longer to see improvement in thar department. But, so far, I'm impressed.

I am obsessed with this. Transitioning from the Clinique cream cleanser because I wanted more bang for my buck and I feel like this delivers. So, so gentle on my sensitive, oily/combo skin. Cleanses nicely without stripping your skin... I'm now able to use my salicylic acid toner for blackheads without it overly drying my skin. Pairs nicely with an exfoliating pad or on its own. Seriously, I will be repurchasing and need a jumbo size. After about a week my skin is so glowy. Love it!

I've been dealing with really bad hormonal acne and not just the time around my period. I would get horrible and painful zits that would scar and be unsightly and nothing I used would get rid of them. That is until this cleanser came into my life, I saw a dermatologist on the clock app talking about how it's wonderful for hormonal acne and she was correct. My skin is smooth, soft, and if I do happen to get acne they don't come to a head and not painful whatsoever. I'm going to recommend this to everyone dealing with bad acne.

Product work's great, turned my face a little red at first then my skin got used to it and now works as it should. The heat made half of the product evaporate sadly and running really low so I will be purchasing again.

Afters years of looking for a good cleanser I finally found the one that works for my skin. I have very sensitive dry skin. I have been struggling with acne for years and this products cleans my face so good and takes of every single makeup product even hard waterproof mascara. My face feels so clean after every wash and did not have any acne ever since I started using it. Just finished my first bottle and will keep on purchasing. I have tried many high end brands which did nothing for my skin also this cleanser was recommended by dermatologist.

I have very oily skin, it literally makes me crazy ! Ive tried numerous fondations, primers, etc to help with no luck. I coild apply make up and within a half hour i was always a grease pit ! This cleaners ans the moiturizer is perfect ! It has helped me tremendously! I will say it didnt take long until my face ended up too dry and i had to switch over to their normal to dry moisturizer. Today i purchased the normal to dry face wash so we will see how it goes, i expect the same wonderful results!

avis.titre: This works really well for my skin
avis.texte: So can we get a bigger bottle of this please?! This cleanser cleans my face without stripping my skin. I definitely recommend this cleanser for my combination to oily skin girls.

I love this cleanser. My skin is 'mature' so using this gentle but thorough product is a pleasure. It removes most makeup as well. I highly recommend it to all ages, especially in winter, when most skin types need a little tenderness.

I legit am obsessed with this facial wash, it is absolutely incredible! I truly do not think I'll be able to buy another facial wash ever again. LaRoche Posay is awesome. My face has felt so soft after using this and I highly recommend trying this product out, you will not be disappointed.
I absolutely adore this cleanser, it works amazing and really works with my skin to the point where it's become a holy grail
I absolutely love this cleanser. A little goes a long way. You need just a drop and lather it in between your hands and it lathers up so much. It leaves my face feeling so soft.

I absolutely love coming home and washing my face with thissss it smells amazing and leaves my skin feeling clean af 🫶🏻 highly recommend if you work hard throughout the day and need to be refreshed when you get home
￼ My dermatologist turned me onto this brand, and I have to say I went out and got the sunblock face cleansing body cream. It is amazing it is a must try

This product is one of my all time favorites because of how well it cleanses my skin removing the dirt and blemishes off of my face Farley quickly. I only use this at night before moisturizing but I can definitely see myself buying this again in the future!!!
I don't know how to feel about it. When I wash it off my face feels like rubber???

I am ABSOLUTLEY in love with this cleanser! I've been using it for several years now, and I've told SO many people about it, that this company should honestly start paying me lol. I have combination skin, so this is especially great for me in summer as it keeps my face matte. Occasionally in winter I get dryer skin, so I tend to switch back and forth between this and Vichy Phytosolution. Its definitely worth the money, I'm 33 and my pores are virtually invisible
Amazing cream I enjoy it very much. It's smooth and creamy not rough and sticky.i recommend this product to everybody it's a very good product to buy
Been using this for about a week now in conjunction with my other LRP products. It has a very good foam, but it also has an odd smell to it at the same time. Not sure it's my favorite.
Best cleanser I've ever used. It removes excess oil and debris, leaves my skin so clean!
I would love to try out this cleanser and the moisturizer because I would love to see if it helps my beautiful skin.

I really like this cleanser because it leaves my face feeling so soft after just 1 wash. I've struggled with acne and this face wash has seemed to help the most out of all of the face washes I have tried . I would highly recommend!!!
I have used this product for many years & love it. It is the only thing I use to wash my face. Removes makeup & doesn't dry my skin.

avis.titre: I'm a La Roche-Posay user for life!
avis.texte: I have been using this cleanser on my super sensitive skin for a few years now. Before using it, I had the most painful adult acne. Now I only get one or two tiny zits when I'm stressed. This help clear them up so fast! Like they were never even there

This product has been the best face cleanser for me ever. I have rosacea and it has been a miracle. My face has improved so much I can't even imagine. I have tried numerous products with no luck, in fact, they would make my skin worse. I am totally sold on this product plus others.

I switched to this from the Toleraine Purifying Foaming Facial Wash. This ended up being quite a bit more drying and also has a lot more fragrance than the other La Roche products I've tried. I have Combination skin and I'm not sure I'll be able to continue to use this product without getting irritated skin.
This has done wonders for face. My face wash before my over drying my skin, and causing weird small, white pimples. This has solved that. The scent is a little odd, but I'll take it.
truly a staple in my skin care routine. amazing job at removing makeup and thoroughly cleansing the skin. have gone through many of these
My skin has never been so clear! I have sensitive acne prone skin and since using this, I have little to no breakouts. It has also helped clear some blackheads on my nose. It's amazing!
The best facial wash ever used for my sensitive skin! Have been using for many years.

THis is my absolute favorite cleanser of all time. It is so deliciously foamy and gets all my makeup off, it feels like it's getting all of the dirt and grime and oils out of my pores. The bang for your buck is there and a bottle lasts for ages! I torture my skin with retinol and AHAs/BHAs and this doesn't strip my skin or further irritate it. I will keep coming back for more and more!

I have really loved this cleanser since my dermatologist recommended it to me a year ago. I have gone through more than a couple bottles and was surprised to find out that my skin did not react to this product (I have severely sensitive skin). In fact, I think this product may have made my sensitivity decrease, especially on my oilier days. I definitely would recommend this cleanser to anyone—it doesn't have any fragrance, its not harsh, it lathers, and it overall makes my face feel very clean.

avis.titre: Not what I was hoping for.
avis.texte: I have very oily skin, but this cleanser stripped my skin of oils and made it feel VERY dry. It did clean my skin though.
Makes my skin feel so soft. Absolutely love it highly recommend to family and friends!

This product is a great morning face wash. It makes your skin feel clean and soft, but can be a bit drying if you use too much. A little goes a long way with this foaming product, which is great because it will last a very long time. Contrary to the inexpensive price tag, it really does leave your skin feeling luxurious. I absolutely recommend this to others.
Literally the best face wash I've ever used. It's a fair price and washes all my makeup off with just one or two pumps of it.
I love this cleanser! It's great because I love a foaming cleaner and it doesn't strip away my skin after. I used this cleanser almost every night and it takes all my makeup off!
Absolutely loved it !! My skin is very sensitive to start off, and on the dry side! This product feels amazing and gives a hydrated plump feel to the skin

I love this product! I was originally using the purifying gel cleanser from skin ceuticals, but wanted something a bit more affordable. I decided to try this out and actually enjoy it more than the expensive option! I also think it is a bit more gentle on my face. Will be continuing to repurchase.
excellent cleaner. I have dry skin and it helps me cleanse and hydrate it at the same time.
I really love this cleanser. It is thick and really get the job done removing all the day's impurities and leaving my skin prepped for my moisturizer.

Great for: Second step in double cleansing process when you need a gentle, non-drying, cleanser not loaded with actives. I like to keep my second step cleanser pretty active free and this always feels soothing and effective. Low to no scent. Great amount of product for the cost.
A great cleanser that I like to keep on rotation. It's very gentle. Doesn't leave your skin feeling stripped and very affordable.
I've been using it for many years and I love it. It doesn't leave my skin dry and cleans perfectly
Good at taking off makeup and lathers really well. Skin doesn't feel dry or tight after using. Good price, but wish they offered in a larger size.
I have combination skin type. This cleaner helped keep oil off my T-Zone but at the same time not drying up my skin. A very gentle cleanser that I would recommend to my friend and family.
cleansers are amazing!! I personally would use then again and definitely recommend. Packaging has changed
I love the wipes and then I use this to cleanse before applying my next skincare sets! Great and light foaming cleanser. My skin truly feels clean afterwards
Absolutely LOVE this face wash. It never disappoints. I just wish it came in a bottle with pump.
I'm 50 years old and my skin need something good. I've tried any brands and find out this working perfectly for me.

This is my favorite and only cleanser. I live for it and it gives my skin a nice clean with no residue and nothing left behind. I'm always pleased with this product. I like the price point and the ingredients
Nice, gentle cleanser . I feel really clean after using in the face . Leaves skin looking radiant

This is my FAVORITE cleanser of all time! It leaves my face feeling clean without that dryness. Definitely worth it! I like a foaming cleanser but one that doesn't strip my moisture- this one does it all!

This one didn't work for me at all. I had high hopes because it says the toleriane line is meant to sensitive skin and this one would work well on oily skin. It did clean well my face but it was too much it was stripy. Even using a really small amount. Also it doesn't work well to remove spf and light makeup as bb cream.

Great foaming cleanser love it so much it cleans my skin really well and gets all my makeup off without needing makeup remover. And it doesn't irritate my very sensitive skin or cause any flare ups so I would recommend this!
It never fails me. Gentle but effective! I've been using it for years and I always go back.
Good product. Not so thick. Cleaned my face and removed some of my blackheads. I would recommend it.
By far my favorite DAILY face wash. Foams amazingly silky, doesn't dry out my skin, and leaves just the perfect amount of moisture to prep for daily face regimen!
Very gentle and effective. Doesn't burn my face. Smells nice too. I have the pump version which gives more and is easier to use.
Great consistency. And it cleansed without over drying my skin. Definitely effective. Would not change a thing about this. Good value for the price.
I have a very oily skin. Even though it makes my face feel clean and fresh I don't feel it lasts as much as I'd like.
This foaming cleanser is really good a lot of my friends have it . From my experience it keeps my face fresh and clean . I've been using it for months and it works wonders .
Love this product! Leaves skin feeling clean but not overly stripped and dry. Foams really well and doesn't leave residue on skin

This cleanser keeps my skin very clean and clear. It's worth every penny. Moisturizing afterwards is a must, but all in all, this product is super effective. I highly recommend this to those who suffer from oily/combination skin.
This product left my skin feeling extremely soft and clean. I have used many of La Roche-Posay products and I am never disappointed! Quality products!
This is a great cleanser for day or night. And let me tell you, a little goes a long way. Doesn't over dry, just a good all-around cleanser.
The only facial cleanser I use! Referred by my dermatologist and she was RIGHT!
This product was recommended by my dermatologist and I can see great results. Is gentle on my skin while cleaning thoroughly. Love it!

Absolutely amazing!! I finally found a facial cleanser that is all around a perfect match for me!! I will never go back to using anything else. I highly highly recommend. My face feels amazing after every use!
i love this cleanser! i put this on my face and washed it after and made my skin so soft..it says it's for oily skin, i also have oily skin and it's amazing! would recommend!
It cleans thoroughly but not drying, it only takes a little bit and foams up beautifully.
This is very gentle on the skin. I cannot tell if it has made a difference but it does seem to smooth and soften my skin.
La Roche-Posay cleansers (hydrating too) provide a luxury experience on a (nearly) drugstore budget. One of the best cleansers I've used in years.

avis.titre: Great face wash! Would definitely recommend
avis.texte: Great product! I use it as my nightly face wash. Removes all makeup
I love this face wash, it is very gentle on my skin and my tube lasts a long time because you use very little!
Just a small amount lathers up well and leaves my face clean nd refreshedd
Have used this cleanser for years and love it for my sensitive skin

avis.titre: Dermatologists know the best skin products!
avis.texte: I have been using this product am and pm for decades. Initially, I was only able to purchase it through my dermatologist. I turn 75 next week, and my facial skin is soft and smooth, and many friends and relatives tell me I do NOT look my age. I have lived in Alaska for over 35 years, so I am sure part of it is little to no sun damage, but I cannot imagine using anything else to cleanse my face!
A little to gentle for me but an overall great cleanser from a great brand. Got off all my makeup. I no longer use it because I found another cleanser by the same brand I prefer.

My dermatologist recommended this cleanser. It is a little too drying for everyday use. It leaves that squeaky clean feeling after using where you feel everything has been stripped off. It is good for removing makeup though. I alternate this product in a couple times a week but not for daily use.
This product clears my face in amount of weeks, the texture when applying is very smooth and light, the scent isn't strong.

This is a great cleanser, my skin is oily sensitive and I love how even though this is a creamy cleanser, my skin feels oil free afterwards without hurting my very sensitive skin. At first I was slightly skeptical of the relatively small amount of product but quickly cake to realize that a little bit of product goes a long way. At the moment my skin is purging due to recently adopting a new skincare routine, but I can tell that this will greatly help my skin and I expect great results.
This is the best face cleanser I have ever used. Leaves me feeling clean and oil free. Thank you!!!

I have oily, uber sensitive skin and have been searching for years for a cleanser that cleans my face without irritation. This is it! Super concentrated, an amount literally the size of a pea thoroughly cleans my oily face without irritation, stripping or over drying.
Loved the texture and lather, but this dried my skin out a lot more than the other Toleriane face wash
After using this cleanser for a couple weeks, I am pleased with the condition of my skin. It is perfect for my sensitive, combination skin. My skin feels clean, yet moisturized. I will reorder soon.

This is my every day face wash. I cannot imagine finding a face wash that I like more than this one. It makes my skin feel very clean without feeling dry at all. It leaves moisture in my skin without leaving any kind of residue. It foams very nicely, and as such, a very small amount goes a long way, so one bottle will last a long time.

Most amazing face wash and makeup remover in one. I have super sensitive skin, and this has been a life changer. Skin is left super clean, removes even the toughest mascara, all without drying out my skin.

I am loving this cleanser. It is gentle but effective. I like the foaming aspect. My skin feels deeply cleansed but not stripped. Have noticed smoother, clearer skin (although I do not suffer from acne, this has helped the overall cleanliness of my skin).

I love this foaming cream, leave my skin soft and moisturizer for long time. Helps me to avoid the crash skins during winter time. The price it's high, but it's really works for the good le results of the product.

Overall, this cleanser is alright. I did like how well it lathered up and cleaned my skin. Also the feeling of it is nice, giving the skin a cooling effect. The things I didn't like; it left my skin a little too dry after cleansing. And it didn't seem to help with breakouts for me either.
A little goes a long way, so this cleanser will last longer than others. It cleans the skin really well, but it's a little bit too dry for my liking. I prefer my cleanser to be more hydrating.
The only down fall of La Roche is the pricing. Buttttt it works great. Dermatologist recommended. Light formula and unscented, it's good for normal to oily skin.
A fantastic deep cleanser, if you live in a city with pollution, or wear a lot of makeup or spf during the day, you should be deep cleansing. I can't go a day without this

This was a pretty good cleanser especially if you have oily skin. My boyfriend who has dry skin did not like this at all. I know it says it moisturizes but I don't think it does. It felt like it dried my skin out more than anything. I didn't mind it in the summer with my skin and I didn't break out. It felt like it stripped my skin though so I am not sure if I would try this again.

avis.titre: This is also one of my...
avis.texte: This is also one of my favorite products. My skin can never have a bad day when I'm using this! its packaging is great and practical. Although it is quite expensive and that's the only reason why I'm not regularly buying this product
I absolutely love this cream cleanser. I originally got it from my dermatologist and I loved it so I ordered it. I also have the Moisturizer and I really love it as well. Definitely would recommend.

I am big fan of La roche posay's Toleriane line in general and this cleanser is one of my favorite products among the line. This is strong enough to remove my light make up yet it does not dry out. Perfect!

I have been using this cleaner for quite a while now and I freak when I run out because it's gentle yet feels like it cleanses well. It doesn't over dry my skin or make it feel itchy or tight. I have tried others like cetaphil but they made me feel greasy and as if it didn't clean my skin at all. This has the perfect balance! I love all my products from this company! My husband loves it as well, he has acne prone skin and also feels like it cleans well without over drying.
A friend referred me to this product, and since I started using I haven't got a single pimple. It leaves my faces squeaky clean.
I love this brand and whenever I use this face wash my face feels clean so that's always a good thing I suppose

I want to start this review by stating that my skin type is combination. This cleanser does a great job with removing all of my makeup but I have noticed that it can be a little drying if I don't immediately follow with a moisturizer.

I've been trying to find a face wash that actually cleans my skin and I can feel cleans my skin. And this one does! It's a cream putting it on but then foams as you massage in. Once I wash it off my skin is no oily or dried out. It feels super clean! And best part no scent. Like really no scent! Amazing product!
Removes my makeup effortlessly, doesn't burn my eyes, doesn't leave a film and leaves my skin feeling balanced and hydrated. Love it!

Laroche-Posay products have saved my skin. I am 55 years old, often told I look like I am in my 40s. I have very sensitive skin. Antiaging products wreaked havoc on my skin. After researching, I simplified my routine and my skin has NEVER looked better. The toleriane purifying foaming cream cleanser cleanses my skin without drying or stripping. My skin is radiant. I also use the the toleriane double repair moisturizer and the laroche-posay micellar water. You do not have to break the bank to have beautiful skin. I have been using Laroche-posay products for a couple of years now. Laroche-posay is my last stop. I no longer have to search for products.
Very greasy and kinda stings. I stopped using it after feeling like it wasn't cleaning my skin

I have been using this product for several years and love it! I love the fact that the foam penetrates and removes all my make-up, is safe to use on my eyelids, and leaves my skin feeling very clean. It has never irritated my sensitive skin.
I have sensitive skin and need to make sure I completely remove make up at the end of the day. This cleanser fits the bill. Highly recommend.
I have a very sensitive and oily pro acne skin. I only use this cleanser when I use makeup because if I'm not wearing makeup and I wash my face with it, my skin feels dry.
I started using Toleriane Purifying Foaming Cream several months ago. My skin feels clean without a trace of impurities!
La Roche Posay Toleriane Purifying Foaming Cream is my favorite face wash so far. It makes your face squeaky clean, soft and fresh. Very gentle, smells light and good. And you need a tiny amount.
I have been using this cleanser since the summer and have loved it through all of the seasons. My skin tends to be dry in the winter and this cleanser didn't make my skin dry.

I have bought this product thinking that it was meant for sensitive skin but I tested the ph and found out that it was so alkaline Waste of money. Also I do not get it why they claim to be so dermatological if the brand do not include the ph information.
This product leaves my skin feeling smooth without any residue. I feel this brand can work on any skin type. I would definitely repurchase this product.
